## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(ui): ...`, `fix: ...`); it becomes the squash commit message
- [ ] Code and comments are in English, UI strings are in Russian
- [ ] No tokens, keys or personal data in code, logs, screenshots or tests
- [ ] README updated if a user-visible feature changed
